result.title: A Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support Framework for Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Integrating Attention-Guided Learning, Explainable AI, and Out-of-Distribution Validation
result.comment: Accepted for presentation at the IC3AI-2026 IEEE conference in Dec 2026. It has been accepted/selected but is not yet published. 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
result.summary: Deep learning models for brain tumor diagnosis need to do more than achieve high classification accuracy. For practical use, they should also provide understandable predictions, recognize unsuitable inputs, and work within a usable clinical system. This paper presents a framework for classifying brain MRI into four categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. The model uses InceptionResNetV2 with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), while Grad-CAM provides visual explanations of its predictions. A two-stage out-of-distribution (OOD) mechanism screens unsuitable inputs using an initial grayscale check followed by Mahalanobis distance, softmax confidence, and predictive entropy. These components are brought together in NeuroScan AI, a real-time web application. Evaluated on a Mendeley brain tumor MRI dataset of 12,064 images, the framework achieved 98.70% validation accuracy, 96.73% test accuracy, and a macro-average AUC of 0.9965. The OOD pipeline achieved 99% detection accuracy on a preliminary 100-image benchmark. Grad-CAM visualizations showed qualitative correspondence with clinically established tumor locations across all four classes. Overall, the work brings classification, explainability, input validation, and deployment into one framework, while recognizing that broader clinical and OOD validation is still required.

AI.brief_summary: 构建脑部 MRI 四分类临床决策支持框架：以 InceptionResNetV2+CBAM 分类、Grad-CAM 提供可视化解释，并用灰度检查加 Mahalanobis 距离、softmax 置信度与预测熵构成的两阶段 OOD 机制筛除不适输入，集成到实时 Web 应用中。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身不涉及 latent 推理，但其基于熵与置信度的输入拒判机制，与 LVR 中「STOP」的停止/弃答决策及不确定性触发证据获取可能有概念联系，可供核查其是否适用于推理期停止策略；CBAM 注意力与 Grad-CAM 仅为分类辅助与事后解释，非内部状态证据。
